sentences.text:
Opposite Party/s  ======================================================
 Appearance :
 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Mritunjay Kumar  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Tarkeshwar Nath Thakur

= = ============================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SATYAVRAT VERMA  ORAL ORDER 2 10-04-2024 1.

Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned A.P.P. for the State along with learned counsel appearing on behal of the O.P. No. 2.
2.

The learned counsel for the petitioner submits that petitioner seeks anticipatory bail in connection with Phulwari Sharif P.S. Case No. 1143 of 2023 registered for the offences punishable under Sections 498A, 341, 323, 504, 506 and 34 of the Indian Penal Code read with Sections 3 and 4 of the Dowry Prohibition Act.
It is further submitted that the investigation in the case is still going on.
3. The learned APP for the State submits that the offences for which the instant FIR has been instituted against the Patna High Court CR.

MISC. No.22053 of 2024(2) dt.10-04-2024 petitioner carries punishment of less than 7 years, the said submission of the learned APP is not disputed by the learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioner and the O.P. No. 2.
4.

In view of the submission made by the learned APP, the anticipatory bail application is disposed of in terms of the order dated 13-2-2024 passed in Criminal Miscellaneous No. 3536 of 2024 Deepak Raj vs The State Of Bihar on 10 April, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/68595297/
1 (Naushad Ansari Vs. The State of Bihar).
5.
